articles.summary: Fourth manufacturer to join the platform since its January 2026 launch GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW) and its wholly-owned subsidiary PEW Logistics LLC, a technology-driven commerce and fulfillment platform company powering the modern firearms and outdoor industry, today announced a strategic collaboration with Sarsilmaz (“Sarsilmaz”), one of the world’s largest privately held, vertically integrated firearms manufacturers, marking the fourth manufacturer to join the PEW Logistics platform. PEW Logistics will power the e-commerce experience at sarsilmaz.us, managing compliant order processing, Federal Firearms Licensee (“FFL”) routing, fulfillment and customer support behind the Sarsilmaz brand. articles.title: GrabAGun's PEW Logistics Adds Sarsilmaz, Extending Platform to a Global-Scale Firearms Manufacturer
